added.current: “Second Young Master, you aren’t going to kill me too, are you?”
added.explanation: Hyuk Mujin is asking Taekyung whether the Second Young Master, Jin Mukyung, will kill him too; the Second Young Master is the subject of the question, not its addressee.
added.replacement: “Second Young Master, he isn’t going to kill me too, is he?”

summary: The unnamed battle cries do not establish a speaker error, but Hyuk Mujin’s question wrongly treats the Second Young Master as the person he is addressing.
